mapper.select: Select b.emp_no as empNo, a.user_no as userNo, a.user_id as userId, a.password as userPassword, a.user_nm as userName, b.dept_code as headCode, b.sub_dept_code as deptCode, SF_PROJ_NAME(b.sub_dept_code) as deptName, C.POSITION_CODE as positionCode, SF_POSITION_NAME(B.POSITION_CODE) as positionName, C.SEQ AS posSeq, a.USE_FG as useFlag From TCC_EMPLOYE a ,THR_PM_BASE b ,THR_POSITION_CODE c Where a.empno = b.EMP_NO AND B.POSITION_CODE = C.POSITION_CODE And a.user_id = #{userId} And a.USE_FG = 'T'

select proj_code as projCode, proj_name as projName from tcc_proj_code e where proj_knd_tg = 'S' and nvl(op_cls,'10') = '10'
and use_tag = 'T' order by proj_code desc

select sati_head_code,sati_dept_code, proj_code as id, sf_proj_name(nvl(sati_dept_code,proj_code))||'>'||'('||proj_code||')'||proj_name as text from tcc_proj_code e where proj_knd_tg in ('S','D') and use_tag = 'T' and nvl(op_cls,'10') = '10' and proj_name NOT like '(신규)%' and sati_dept_code not in (2012,2031) and proj_code in (Select distinct PROJ_CODE From Table(SFCC_AUTH_PROJ2(#{user_no}))) order by sati_head_code,sati_dept_code,proj_code desc
select emp_no id , name||' '||sf_position_name(position_code)||'('||sf_proj_name(sub_dept_code)||')' text from thr_pm_base where retired_dt is null

Select b.emp_no as empNo, a.user_no as userNo, a.user_id as userId, a.user_nm as userName, b.sub_dept_code as deptCode, SF_PROJ_NAME(b.sub_dept_code) as deptName From TCC_EMPLOYE a ,THR_PM_BASE b ,THR_POSITION_CODE c Where a.empno = b.EMP_NO AND B.POSITION_CODE = C.POSITION_CODE AND B.sub_dept_code = 0107 AND b.emp_cls_code in ('001','004') And a.USE_FG = 'T' order by b.emp_no

select emp_no id , name||' '||sf_position_name(position_code)||'('||sf_proj_name(sub_dept_code)||')' text from thr_pm_base where retired_dt is null and position_code in ('41','40','06','08','27') and dept_code = #{headCode}

Select b.emp_no as empNo, a.user_no as userNo, a.user_id as userId, null as userPassword, a.user_nm as userName, b.sub_dept_code as deptCode, SF_PROJ_NAME(b.sub_dept_code) as deptName, sf_position_name(b.position_code) as positionName From TCC_EMPLOYE a ,THR_PM_BASE b Where a.empno = b.EMP_NO And a.empno = #{emp_no}

SELECT a.CUST_CODE, a.BIZ_NO, a.CUST_NAME, a.BOSS_NAME, a.TRADE_CLS, nvl(a.ELCT_TAG,'F') ELCT_TAG, nvl(a.pay_stop_cls,'T') pay_stop_cls, a.ADDR1||' '||a.ADDR2 CUST_ADD, a.TELNO FROM TCC_CUST a WHERE a.ACCOUNT_WORK = 'T' AND (a.BIZ_NO||a.CUST_NAME like '%'||#{custCode}||'%' OR a.CUST_NAME like '%'||#{custCode}||'%' OR a.CUST_CODE like '%'||#{custCode}||'%') AND ROWNUM <= 500 ORDER BY a.CUST_NAME, a.BIZ_NO, a.CUST_CODE

select a.emp_no, b.user_no, a.name, a.e_mail as email, sf_position_name(a.position_code) as position_name, sf_proj_name(a.dept_code) as dept_name, sf_proj_name(a.sub_dept_code) as proj_name from thr_pm_base a, tcc_employe b where a.emp_no = b.empno and emp_no = #{emp_no}
Select SCC_E_CONF_STATUS_SEQ.NextVal MST_SEQ From Dual
Select SCC_CUSTCODE.NextVal CUST_CODE From Dual
Select NVL(Count(*),0) CUST_CNT From TCC_CUST a Where a.BIZ_NO = SF_CUST_UMASK(#{bizNo})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.CUST_CODE as id, a.CUST_NAME || ' (' || Decode(a.TRADE_CLS,'1',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO),'2',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO), a.BIZ_NO) || ')' as text, a.CUST_NAME as custName, Decode(a.TRADE_CLS,'1',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO),'2',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO), a.BIZ_NO) as bizNoMasked, Decode(a.TRADE_CLS,'1',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO),'2',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO), a.BIZ_NO) as bizNo FROM TCC_CUST a WHERE a.ACCOUNT_WORK = 'T' AND a.BIZ_NO = SF_CUST_UMASK(#{bizNo}) ORDER BY a.CUST_NAME, a.BIZ_NO, a.CUST_CODE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500

SELECT a.CUST_CODE as id, a.CUST_NAME as custName, Decode(a.TRADE_CLS,'1',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO),'2',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO), a.BIZ_NO) as bizNoMasked, Decode(a.TRADE_CLS,'1',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO),'2',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO), a.BIZ_NO) as bizNo, a.CUST_NAME || ' (' || Decode(a.TRADE_CLS,'1',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO),'2',SF_Cust_Mask(a.BIZ_NO), a.BIZ_NO) || ')' as text FROM TCC_CUST a WHERE a.ACCOUNT_WORK = 'T' AND a.BIZ_NO = SF_CUST_UMASK(#{bizNo}) AND ROWNUM <= 5

Select (Nvl(MAX(A.MAKE_SEQ),0)+1) MAKE_SEQ, Replace(#{makeDt},'-','')||'-'||#{makeProj}||'-'||(Nvl(MAX(A.MAKE_SEQ),0)+1) MAKE_DOC_NO From TCC_E_CONF_STATUS A Where A.MAKE_PROJ = #{makeProj} And A.MAKE_DT = SF_StringToDate(#{makeDt})
Select Nvl(MAX(A.E_DOC_NAME),'') E_DOC_NAME, Nvl(MAX(A.E_DOC_CODE),'') E_DOC_CODE From TCC_E_DOC_CODE A Where EAID = #{eaId}
SELECT A.BANK_MAIN_CODE as id, A.BANK_MAIN_NAME as text FROM TIA_BANK_MAIN A WHERE A.USE_TAG = 'T' ORDER BY A.BANK_MAIN_CODE
SELECT user_nm FROM tcc_employe WHERE empno = #{emp_no}
SELECT SFCC_E_CONF_STATUS_LAST(#{mstSeq}) FROM DUAL

SELECT cust_code, TO_CHAR(req_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') as req_dt, req_emp_no, app_emp_no, app_tg, proj_code, biz_no, cust_name, boss_name, trade_cls, bizcond, bizknd, zipcode, addr1, addr2, telno, head_fax, bank_main_code, cust_accno, c_owner, tax_cls FROM tcc_cust_proj WHERE cust_code = #{cust_code}
